name: regions
crs_note: coordinates are source-image pixels of assets/maps/source/base_map.webp (x right, y down); see docs/COORDINATES.md

properties.name: Laurel City
properties.desc: Larger west city on the Laurel River: downtown towers, rail yard, SR 400 / SR 9 freeways.

properties.name: Laurel Gap corridor
properties.desc: Rural transition along US 19 between Laurel City and Hollow Ridge: farms, Bald Ridge, Laurel Gap.

properties.name: Hollow Ridge
properties.desc: Old Appalachian town grown along US 19 (Main St), Falls Creek, and the Georgia Northern depot.

properties.name: North highlands (Stony Knob)
properties.desc: Central Appalachian high country: Falls Creek gorge, Stony Knob massif.

properties.name: South Fork highlands
properties.desc: South Fork gorge, Hollow Creek, Dockery farm, forested ridges.

properties.name: Tanner Valley corridor
properties.desc: Rural transition between Hollow Ridge and Tannersville: Harmony Grove, Tanner Pike, the Tanner meanders.

properties.name: Tannersville
properties.desc: Larger east city at the Tanner / North Branch confluence: downtown, arena, rail yard, SR 60 / US 76.
